correctness.rationale: The Gram integrals and A−2B=∫(φ(u)−φ(1−u))²du>0 give an invertible Toeplitz Gram operator. The geometric inverse solves the off-diagonal recurrence and gives 1 at the origin by A−2Bq=Δ. The continuous symmetric kernel has uniformly integrable rows by geometric decay. K(x,x)>0 by positive definiteness of the inverse on the nonzero local basis vector; hence the Lebesgue function is positive. In each open cell, a nonzero kernel section satisfies K″=θ²K and any zero gives a nonnegative derivative jump for |K|, so integration gives strict convexity and knots-only maxima. Continuous outputs from bounded compactly supported truncations of the sign of a knot row show that the row maximum is the sharp essential-supremum norm; symmetry and L¹/L∞ duality give sharpness on L¹. The nodal integral is twice a geometric series times its single-crossing cell integral. For a check of the Taylor term, put C=cosh θ, α(q)=(1+q²)/(1+q), β(q)=q²/(1+q)^3. The cell-integral numerator is α(q)(C−1)+β(q)(C−1)²+O((C−1)³). With r=2−√3 and κ=−r/(5√3), this gives J=α(r)/2+θ²[−α(r)/24+β(r)/4+κα′(r)/2]+O(θ⁴). Dividing by Δ(1−q) and including the factor 2 gives 2+θ²/120+O(θ⁴). At large θ, Δ∼1/θ, q→0 and |J−tanh(θ/2)/θ|≤q tanh(θ/2)/θ. Continuity and the two endpoint limits yield attainment above 2 at finite positive θ, not uniqueness. Replay: RESULT.md proof §§1–4 (especially lines 37–97). The supplied check.py was inspected, not run; it uses floating-point checks and a cell antiderivative shared with the formula, plus a separate quadrature check of the row. Neither is the proof.

value.rationale: The norm measures exact worst-case endpoint amplification for a standard tension-parameterized least-squares approximation. Neither a universal spline bound nor the limiting polynomial case decides whether introducing tension improves or worsens the constant. The formula, knots-only extremizers of the Lebesgue function, and rigorously nonmonotone positive-tension behavior answer that question without inferring it from sampling. No location or uniqueness of the best tension is asserted.
